title: Headlines and formal written words
focus: Words common in writing but rarer in speech: 进行 表示 发展 认为 通过 关于 根据 目前 增加 影响; reading simple news headlines.
body:
# Headlines and formal written words

Written Chinese, especially news, uses a different set of words for things you already say every day. You would say 他说, but a newspaper writes 他表示 or 他称. Most of these written words have a spoken word you already know. If you match each written word to its spoken one, a news headline gets much easier to read.

Headlines also cut words. They drop 了 and 的, and use single characters like 将, 已 and 未 where speech uses two (会/要, 已经, 还没).

| Written | Pinyin | Spoken |
|---|---|---|
| 进行 | jìnxíng | 做, 搞 |
| 表示 · 称 · 宣布 | biǎoshì · chēng · xuānbù | 说 |
| 认为 | rènwéi | 觉得 |
| 目前 | mùqián | 现在 |
| 增加 · 减少 | zēngjiā · jiǎnshǎo | 多了 · 少了 |
| 举行 | jǔxíng | 办, 开 |
| 将 | jiāng | 会, 要 |
| 于 | yú | 在 |
| 已 · 未 | yǐ · wèi | 已经 · 还没 |
| 均 | jūn | 都 |
| 及 | jí | 和 |
| 此 · 其 | cǐ · qí | 这 · 他的/它的 |

## Examples

- 双方进行了会谈。 shuāngfāng jìnxíngle huìtán: The two sides held talks.
- 他表示同意。 tā biǎoshì tóngyì: He said he agreed.
- 目前还没有消息。 mùqián hái méiyǒu xiāoxi: There's no news yet.
- 根据天气预报,明天有雨。 gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān yǒu yǔ: According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
- 大雨影响了交通。 dàyǔ yǐngxiǎngle jiāotōng: Heavy rain disrupted traffic.
- 会议将在明天举行。 huìyì jiāng zài míngtiān jǔxíng: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
- 结果未公布。 jiéguǒ wèi gōngbù: The results have not been announced.
- 据报道,已有三人受伤。 jù bàodào, yǐ yǒu sān rén shòushāng: Three people are reported injured.
- 北京明天将有大雨 Běijīng míngtiān jiāng yǒu dàyǔ: Heavy rain expected in Beijing tomorrow
- 物价继续上涨 wùjià jìxù shàngzhǎng: Prices keep rising

## Common mistakes

- **未 vs 末.** 未 (wèi, not yet) has the longer line at the bottom. 末 (mò, end, as in 周末) has the longer line on top.
- **于 vs 干, 已 vs 己.** 于 (yú) ends in a hook, and 干 (gàn) ends in a straight line. 已 (yǐ, already) is half closed, 己 (jǐ, self) is open, and 巳 (sì) is fully closed.

cards.Example: 双方进行了会谈。 shuāngfāng jìnxíngle huìtán: The two sides held talks.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 做 / 搞; 行 is xíng here, not háng

cards.Example: 他表示同意。 tā biǎoshì tóngyì: He said he agreed.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 说; 表 is the same as in 手表 (watch)

cards.Example: 这个城市发展得很快。 zhège chéngshì fāzhǎn de hěn kuài: This city is developing fast.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 变大 / 变好 / 越来越好; 展 has 尸 on top

cards.Example: 专家认为问题不大。 zhuānjiā rènwéi wèntí bú dà: Experts think it's not a big problem.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 觉得; 为 is wéi here, wèi in 为什么

cards.Example: 这个计划已经通过了。 zhège jìhuà yǐjīng tōngguò le: The plan has been approved.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 过了 (passed) or 用 / 靠 (by means of); both have 辶

cards.Example: 关于这个问题,大家有什么意见? guānyú zhège wèntí, dàjiā yǒu shénme yìjiàn: What does everyone think about this?
cards.Notes: Speech says 说到… or …的事; 关 is the 关 in 关门

cards.Example: 根据天气预报,明天有雨。 gēnjù tiānqì yùbào, míngtiān yǒu yǔ: According to the forecast, it will rain tomorrow.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 按照 / 听…说; 根 = 木 + 艮 gèn, 据 = 扌 + 居 jū

cards.Example: 目前还没有消息。 mùqián hái méiyǒu xiāoxi: There's no news yet.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 现在; 目 is 'eye', literally 'before the eyes'

cards.Example: 学生人数增加了。 xuésheng rénshù zēngjiā le: The number of students went up.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 多了 / 加; 增 = 土 + 曾 céng for the sound

cards.Example: 大雨影响了交通。 dàyǔ yǐngxiǎngle jiāotōng: Heavy rain disrupted traffic.
cards.Notes: Speech often says 搞得 / 弄得; 影 = 景 jǐng + 彡, 响 = 口 + 向 xiàng

cards.Example: 婚礼在上海举行。 hūnlǐ zài Shànghǎi jǔxíng: The wedding is being held in Shanghai.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 办 / 开; 举 is the 举 in 举手 (raise a hand)

cards.Example: 公司提高了工资。 gōngsī tígāole gōngzī: The company raised salaries.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 加 / 变高; 提 = 扌 hand + 是 shì

cards.Example: 车祸减少了。 chēhuò jiǎnshǎo le: Car accidents have gone down.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 少了; 减 has 冫, while 喊 (hǎn, shout) has 口

cards.Example: 公司宣布明天放假。 gōngsī xuānbù míngtiān fàngjià: The company announced tomorrow is a day off.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 说 / 告诉大家; 宣 = 宀 roof + 亘

cards.Example: 大雨还会继续。 dàyǔ hái huì jìxù: The heavy rain will continue.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 接着 / 还在; 继 has 纟 silk, unlike 断 (duàn, break)

cards.Example: 会议将在明天举行。 huìyì jiāng zài míngtiān jǔxíng: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 会 / 要; 丬 + 夕 + 寸

cards.Example: 他生于北京。 tā shēng yú Běijīng: He was born in Beijing.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 在; 于 ends in a hook, 干 (gàn) does not

cards.Example: 会议已结束。 huìyì yǐ jiéshù: The meeting has ended.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 已经; lookalikes 己 jǐ (open) / 已 yǐ (half closed) / 巳 sì (closed)

cards.Example: 两人均已离开。 liǎng rén jūn yǐ líkāi: Both have left.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 都; 均 = 土 + 匀 yún

cards.Example: 结果未公布。 jiéguǒ wèi gōngbù: The results have not been announced.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 没 / 还没; 未 has the long line at the bottom, 末 (mò) on top

cards.Example: 他称自己不知道。 tā chēng zìjǐ bù zhīdào: He says he didn't know.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 说; 称 = 禾 grain + 尔 ěr; 据称 = reportedly

cards.Example: 老师及学生 lǎoshī jí xuésheng: teachers and students
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 和; lookalike 乃 (nǎi)

cards.Example: 其中一人受伤。 qízhōng yì rén shòushāng: One of them was injured.
cards.Notes: 其 is written for 他的 / 它的 / 他们的; it is also the sound part in 期 qī and 旗 qí

cards.Example: 因此会议推迟了。 yīncǐ huìyì tuīchí le: So the meeting was postponed.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 所以; 此 (= 这) is 止 + 匕

cards.Example: 据报道,已有三人受伤。 jù bàodào, yǐ yǒu sān rén shòushāng: Three people are reported injured.
cards.Notes: Written counterpart of 听说 / 新闻说; 据 alone is short for 根据

cards.Example: 记者在现场。 jìzhě zài xiànchǎng: Reporters are at the scene.
cards.Notes: 者 (person who) is also the left half of 都

cards.Example: 政府表示会尽快解决。 zhèngfǔ biǎoshì huì jǐnkuài jiějué: The government says it will deal with it soon.
cards.Notes: 政 = 正 zhèng for the sound + 攵; 府 = 广 + 付 fù

cards.Meaning: Heavy rain expected in Beijing tomorrow
cards.Notes: Headline style: 将 replaces 会, and there's no 。 at the end
涨 is zhǎng (rise) here; 张 zhāng has 弓 instead of 氵

cards.Meaning: Leaders of the two countries hold talks
cards.Notes: 两国 = 两个国家; headlines drop the measure word
